description:
The tube design is MAGICAL......can you guess the main ingredient?

Yes it's a mascarpone ice cream with basically ALL the add ins B&J's could find. Saying that, the crunch from the shortbread is amazing combined with the sticky fudge swirl. The actual ice cream steals the limelight here though, the mascarpone makes an amazing ice cream thatwill be sure to delight anyone who tries it. 

What will you need for this?

Ice Cream:
120g Sugar
400ml Whole milk
400g Mascarpone cheese
40g Corn Syrup/Golden Syrup
40g Dextrose
15g Skimmed Milk Powder
10g Butter
1.1g Stabilizer blend
1/4 Tsp Vanilla Extract
A pinch of salt
0.5 tsp silk gel (or another emulsifier)

Fudge Swirl:
110g Sugar
25g Cocoa powder
57g Butter
65ml milk
1.5 tbsp corn syrup/golden syrup 
.5 tablespoon vanilla extract

Espresso Fudge:
340g of 50% Chocolate
400g Can sweetened condensed milk
2 tbsp Espresso powder

Ganache Top:
50g of 50% Chocolate
1 Tsp Deoderized Coconut Oil

Shortbread:
We used shop bought here but this recipe from BBC Good Food works very well. https://www.bbcgoodfood.com/recipes/shortbread-biscuits

As you can see, there's a lot going in to this Ben & Jerry's ice cream, too much maybe??? Once you make it, you'll not be dissapointed 😉


If you enjoyed this video, please consider liking and subscribing, plus pop over to our Instagram and Facebook pages linked below and say hello :)

Website: https://polaricecreamery.com/


Thanks and see you on the next video :)

Nick
